description: Lists properties and responses of cable elements in the range. If no keyword is given, the default output of the command is that associated with the information keyword.

keywords.name: force-axial
keywords.description: axial forces exerted by the nodes on the element

keywords.name: force-node
keywords.description: list nodal forces. By default, components are displayed in terms of the element local coordinate systems. These are the forces exerted by the nodes on the element. Options: local: list forces in terms of the element local coordinate system (the default); global: list forces in terms of the global coordinate system

keywords.name: force-node-local
keywords.description: list forces in terms of the element local coordinate system (the default)

keywords.name: force-node-global
keywords.description: list forces in terms of the global coordinate system

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: list group to which the element belongs. By default, lists all slots with group assignments. If the slot keyword is used, only the contents of that slot is listed.

keywords.name: information
keywords.description: lists general element information, including id and component-id numbers, connected nodes, centroids, surface area, volume, and the hide and select status

keywords.name: property
keywords.syntax: property {density | youngs | poisson | grout-cohesion | grout-friction | grout-stiffness | grout-perimeter | plastic-moment | slide | slide-tolerance | tensile-failure-strain | thermal-expansion | cross-sectional-area | yield-compression | yield-tension} ... [range]
keywords.description: Options: density: density, \(ρ\); youngs: Young’s modulus, \(E\); poisson: Poisson’s ratio, \(ν\); grout-cohesion: grout cohesive strength, \(c_g\); grout-friction: grout friction angle, \(φ_g\); grout-stiffness: grout stiffness, \(k_g\); grout-perimeter: grout exposed perimeter, \(p_g\); plastic-moment: plastic moment, \(M^P\); slide: sliding flag; slide-tolerance: sliding tolerance; tensile-failure-strain: tensile failure strain (nondimensional); thermal-expansion: thermal expansion coefficient, \(α_t\); cross-sectional-area: cross-sectional area, \(A\); yield-compression: compressive yield strength, \(F_c\); yield-tension: tensile yield strength, \(F_t\)

keywords.name: yield
keywords.description: indicator of whether or not the element itself has yielded

keywords.name: apply
keywords.description: axial tension that will be maintained during cycling

keywords.name: force-axial
keywords.description: axial force in the cable (average of the two end forces)

keywords.name: force-node
keywords.description: generalized nodal forces (force and moment) acting on the element. These are the generalized forces exerted by the nodes on the element. Options: local: express the values in the element coordinate system (the default); global: express the values in the global coordinate system

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: group assignment(s). If slot is specified, then list the group assignment, if any, in slot s .

keywords.name: grout
keywords.description: information about the grout that is modeled as coupling springs that connect the cable to the target object (zones in FLAC3D and 3DEC, and particles in PFC3D): confinement, displacement, stress, yield state and average axial direction

keywords.name: information
keywords.description: general element information: nodal connectivity, centroid, surface area, volume, and hide/select status

keywords.name: property
keywords.syntax: property {cross-sectional-area <f> | density <f> | grout-cohesion <f> | grout-cohesion-table <s> | grout-friction <f> | grout-friction-table <s> | grout-perimeter <f> | grout-stiffness <f> | slide <b> | slide-tolerance <f> | tensile-failure-strain <f> | thermal-expansion <f> | yield-compression <f> | yield-tension <f> | young <f>} [scaled <bscaled>]
keywords.description: Scaled properties are returned if the scaled keyword ( FLAC2D ONLY ) is set to true (the default is false). If the property cannot be scaled, an error is emitted. Options: cross-sectional-area <f>: cross-sectional area; density <f>: mass density; grout-cohesion <f>: grout cohesion per unit length; grout-cohesion-table <s>: name of the table relating grout cohesion to relative shear displacement; grout-friction <f>: grout friction angle; grout-friction-table <s>: name of the table relating grout friction angle to relative shear displacement; grout-perimeter <f>: grout exposed perimeter; grout-stiffness <f>: grout stiffness per unit length; slide <b>: large-strain sliding flag; slide-tolerance <f>: large-strain sliding tolerance; tensile-failure-strain <f>: tensile failure strain; thermal-expansion <f>: thermal-expansion coefficient; yield-compression <f>: compressive yield strength; yield-tension <f>: tensile yield strength; young <f>: Young’s modulus

keywords.name: stress
keywords.description: axial stress in the cable (not to be confused with stress in the grout)

keywords.name: yield
keywords.description: yield state indicating whether or not the cable has yielded
